name: Panoramagasthaus Neue Gufl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Panoramagasthaus Neue Gufl in Tulfes**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, just a stone’s throw from **Innsbruck**, **Panoramagasthaus Neue Gufl** invites you to experience authentic alpine hospitality with breathtaking views. Whether you’re seeking relaxation or adventure, our cozy mountain retreat offers warmth, tradition, and the finest local flavors.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain trout, all crafted with regional ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tulfes** and beyond, unwind in our rustic yet modern rooms—each designed to make you feel at home.

From our sunlit terrace with panoramic vistas to our welcoming fireplace lounge, every corner of **Neue Gufl** promises an unforgettable stay. Come taste the soul of the Alps—where tradition meets tranquility.

**Willkommen im Panoramagasthaus Neue Gufl in Tulfes!**
